verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of starting an audio or video call from a Discord channel or DM inside the client. The voice-chat mentions all concern the Discord Social SDK, a developer building block for adding voice to games. "HD video streaming" is a Nitro streaming-quality perk, an adjacent feature rather than call initiation. "Space to talk" is generic marketing copy.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app
